title: The Unforgiven Ledger of Taneth
summary: Hunt down a Great War traitor-magnate who sold Taneth's gates to the Thalmor and now uses Iron Wheel mercenaries and slavers in Thrall Cove and Bahraha's Gloom to silence the survivors.

npcs.name: Oath-Keeper Samira of Taneth
npcs.greet: Read the names chiseled into the sea-wall of Taneth, stranger. Every stone remembers the night our gate was sold to the Dominion.
talk: In Taneth and Abah's Landing, we swear the Oath of No Forgiveness against the collaborators who took Thalmor gold during the Great War.
Last night someone murdered the old harbour-archivist and stole the Iron Casket containing the true signatures of the Traitor-Syndicate. Speak with Fence-Master Zayd in Abah's Landing.

npcs.name: Fence-Master Zayd
npcs.greet: Look, we pick pockets and lighten merchant barges in Abah's Landing—we don't traffic with Dominion collaborators or Thrall Cove slavers!
talk: Merchant-Magnate Hazaq—who sits on the syndicate board under a bought name—hired slaver-corsairs in Thrall Cove to smuggle the Iron Casket out to sea.
Catch Slaver-Captain Murad at Thrall Cove before his galley weighs anchor!

npcs.name: Captain Leila of the Quays
npcs.greet: Toss a coin into Nocturnal's fountain for luck, blade-for-hire. You'll need it where Hazaq has gone.
talk: When you burned Murad's skiffs at Thrall Cove, Magnate Hazaq fled with the Iron Casket into the sealed family tomb of Bahraha's Gloom.
He has hired necromancers and disgraced mercenaries to hold the catacombs until a Thalmor cutter arrives at No Shira Citadel.

npcs.name: Warden Qasim of the Iron-Watch
npcs.greet: Our coastal batteries at No Shira Citadel just drove off an unmarked elven schooner!
talk: Magnate Hazaq has nowhere left to run. He is trapped inside Bahraha's Gloom with the traitor-ledger.
Go in, execute the Oath of No Forgiveness, and bring the Iron Casket back to Taneth!

story_hb_abahs_landing_bridge: Fence-Master Zayd: Look at this gold eagle dropped by the archivist's killers—stamped with an Aldmeri eagle on one side and a Thrall Cove slave-tally on the other.
Oath-Keeper Samira of Taneth: Then one of the syndicate lords in Abah's Landing is the surviving traitor of the East Gate!
Fence-Master Zayd: Hit Thrall Cove now before Captain Murad loads the Iron Casket onto his galley!
story_hb_thrall_cove_jetty: Slaver-Captain Murad: Magnate Hazaq paid double freight to sink that Iron Casket in the Abecean trench! You won't take this jetty alive!
Captain Leila of the Quays: Cut the gangplank ropes and take Murad's head!
story_hb_bahraha_vault: Magnate Hazaq: Half of Taneth's merchant houses ate bread bought with my Dominion gold when the siege-lines starved!
Oath-Keeper Samira of Taneth: And four thousand died when you unbarred the postern gate, Hazaq! The Oath of Taneth knows no statute of years!

quests.title: The Stolen Roll of the East Gate
quests.summary: Trace the stolen Iron Casket of Taneth to Fence-Master Zayd in Abah's Landing.
intro: The Iron Casket containing the original Great War collaborator signatures has been stolen from Taneth's harbour archives.
Speak with Oath-Keeper Samira in Taneth and travel to Abah's Landing to question Fence-Master Zayd.
complete: In Abah's Landing, Zayd identified a Thrall Cove tally-coin linking the theft to Magnate Hazaq and Slaver-Captain Murad.

journal.start: Oath-Keeper Samira in Taneth sent me to Abah's Landing to trace the stolen Iron Casket.
journal.done: Fence-Master Zayd traced the stolen casket to Slaver-Captain Murad at Thrall Cove.

quests.title: Blood on the Slave-Jetty
quests.summary: Storm Thrall Cove, defeat Slaver-Captain Murad, and meet Captain Leila in the Thieves Den.
intro: Slaver-Captain Murad is preparing to sail from Thrall Cove to dump the Iron Casket in deep water for Magnate Hazaq.
Raid Thrall Cove, defeat Captain Murad, and consult Captain Leila at the Thieves Den.
complete: Slaver-Captain Murad fell on the jetty, and Captain Leila revealed that Magnate Hazaq fled with the casket into Bahraha's Gloom.

journal.start: I must raid Thrall Cove, defeat Slaver-Captain Murad, and speak with Captain Leila in the Thieves Den.
journal.done: I defeated Slaver-Captain Murad and learned Magnate Hazaq is hiding in Bahraha's Gloom.

quests.title: Guns of No Shira Citadel
quests.summary: Alert Warden Qasim at No Shira Citadel to block Magnate Hazaq's sea escape.
intro: Magnate Hazaq signaled an unmarked schooner off the peninsula to pick him up near No Shira Citadel.
Check the signal-promontory at Zeht's Displeasure and alert Warden Qasim at No Shira Citadel.
complete: Warden Qasim's coastal batteries drove off the schooner, trapping Magnate Hazaq inside Bahraha's Gloom.

journal.start: I must check Zeht's Displeasure and alert Warden Qasim at No Shira Citadel.
journal.done: Warden Qasim drove off Hazaq's escape ship from No Shira Citadel.

quests.title: The Oath of No Forgiveness
quests.summary: Descend into Bahraha's Gloom, defeat Magnate Hazaq the Gate-Seller, and return the Iron Casket to Oath-Keeper Samira in Taneth.
intro: Trapped inside the catacombs of Bahraha's Gloom, Magnate Hazaq is guarded by his last mercenaries and tomb-thralls.
Enter Bahraha's Gloom, defeat Hazaq, and bring the Iron Casket back to Oath-Keeper Samira in Taneth.
complete: Magnate Hazaq has answered for the betrayal of the East Gate, the Iron Casket rests once more in Taneth, and you have been awarded the Hew's Bane Scimitar.

journal.done: I defeated Magnate Hazaq in Bahraha's Gloom and received the Hew's Bane Scimitar in Taneth.
